limitations: The registry is selected by a trusted local operator, not accepted from an import request. Its metadata/registration is not authenticated cloud authority.

The pure function checks expected review parent at preview time only. A future authenticated persistence transaction must recheck it and implement deduplication/leases. Stable import keys do not prove atomic import persistence.
AWAITING_EXTRACTION_REVIEW means candidate integrity and scope inventory consistency, not source accuracy, accepted reading order, legal approval or publication.

Only complete selected native pages and the fixed partial image-table reconstruction are supported. General native table import, OCR-region edits, exclusions, footnotes, cross-page acceptance and multilingual completeness remain held/unsupported.
The table keeps nineteen exact saved blank states, zero unresolved cell states and 292 unplaced characters, with unresolved structure/context. No blanket acceptance is inferred from blank choices.
The known Hindi header edit and historical feedback remain as proposals/evidence. No owner feedback is upgraded into authenticated reviewer identity or tax authority.
Local registered original page counts are checked with the PDF parser during demonstration registration; the pure validator trusts server registration and does not parse original PDFs.
No application endpoint, sign-in/capability grant, cloud storage, production migration, model/OCR call, chunk, embedding or index write.
